overview: The Medford City Council recognized local community members and veterans, discussed traffic safety and hybrid meeting technology, and referred the proposed FY2022 budget and a Zoning Board of Appeals expansion back to committee.

items.title: Commendation of MHS JV Baseball Player Kaylee Laidlaw
items.summary: The council approved a resolution commending Kaylee Laidlaw for becoming the first female player on the Medford High School JV baseball team.

items.title: Sarah Bradley Fulton Day Resolution
items.summary: The council approved a resolution recognizing Revolutionary War heroine Sarah Bradley Fulton and designating a day in early October in her honor.

items.title: Recognition of American Legion Post 45 and D-Day Commemoration
items.summary: The council passed a combined resolution honoring American Legion Post 45 for decorating veterans' graves and commemorating the 77th anniversary of D-Day.

items.title: Medford Chess Club Riverside Park Upgrades
items.summary: The council discussed supporting outdoor Medford Chess Club meetings at Riverside Avenue Park and placed the amended proposal on the next agenda for a formal vote.

items.title: Reappointment Discussion for City Clerk
items.summary: The council voted to hold a Committee of the Whole meeting to discuss the upcoming reappointment of the City Clerk.

items.title: ARPA Expenditure Reporting Resolution
items.summary: The council approved an amended resolution requesting monthly written reports from the administration on the allocation and public input process for American Rescue Plan Act funds.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Ralph Scopa
items.summary: The council approved a resolution expressing condolences to the family of retired city employee Ralph Scopa.

items.title: Hybrid Meeting Technology Upgrades
items.summary: The council approved an amended resolution calling on the administration to outfit additional public meeting rooms with hybrid technology and request cost and timeline estimates from Medford Community Media.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments Third Reading
items.summary: The council passed the third reading of proposed amendments to the personnel ordinances.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents addressed the council regarding civic values, school flag displays, and public participation procedures at School Committee meetings.

items.title: High Street Traffic Safety Report
items.summary: The council reviewed a traffic engineering report on High Street modifications and referred broader traffic and bus service concerns to a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Public Hearing on Zoning Board of Appeals Expansion
items.summary: The council referred a proposed zoning amendment expanding the Zoning Board of Appeals back to the Office of Community Development to reset advertising deadlines.

items.title: Submission of FY2022 City Budget
items.summary: The council referred the mayor's proposed $191.7 million FY2022 city budget to the Committee of the Whole for review.

items.title: Committee Reports and Approval of Records
items.summary: The council approved committee reports and meeting records from prior sessions.
